Classification: Incident dementia: dementia at any follow-up assessment and alive at the final wave
Missing intermediate assessment, dementia identified later
Adequately observed non-dementia: confirmed dementia-free at final wave
Missing assessments, subsequently confirmed dementia-free at final assessment
Loss to follow-up: alive or vital status unknown, no final-wave assessment
Outcome not available: dementia status undetermined after final interview
Death: died before final wave, any dementia history
